what: SHA-256 of the six reference files written by loomora_refgen (basic, empty, escape40, multi, multi-light, one). Reference = the six hashes of the golden constants of core/tests/format_selftest.cpp, held once in the files stored under validation/evidence/adr-0021/windows-11-x64/. Files byte-identical to the reference are not stored again (ADR 0014); only their hash is recorded here.
platform_note: NOT RUN IN FIREFOX 10, NOT RUN ON WINDOWS 2000. The JavaScript builds below were built and run under node in the WSL distribution Ubuntu 26.04: the Windows 2000 VM of validation/platforms/windows-2000-x86.json was not started and no browser loaded these files, so this proves bytes and logic of the JavaScript path, not the browser, its JavaScript engine or the XMLHttpRequest loading of the page. The sizes are those of the reference files: the run recorded the six SHA-256 (core/tests/android_results.json / web_results.json of the main repository), not the sizes, and an equal SHA-256 means equal bytes.
